title: A Prometheus metrics endpoint is public
summary: The metrics endpoint answers unauthenticated, which leaks internal paths, counts and sometimes versions.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.
confirm.differential: status==200 and "html" not in header("content-type") and body_contains("# HELP") and body_contains("# TYPE") and body_differs(control)

remediate: Put the metrics endpoint behind authentication or an allow list.
